verdict.rationale: Lium's API docs point to a downloadable OpenAPI spec at https://lium.io/api/openapi.json and show it being fed to openapi-typescript for type generation, so a machine-readable spec is offered directly. The probe's 404s were on docs.lium.io paths, not the documented lium.io/api/openapi.json URL, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the documented spec URL resolves, and fuller documentation of the spec's scope and versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
